run_deformable_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads and animates soft body cloth objects with deformable physics
create_softbody_cloth: create a soft body cloth object using loadSoftBody with bending springs and mass spring parameters
remove_body_from_simulation: remove a soft body object from the active pybullet simulation using removeBody
reset_deformable_world: reset the pybullet simulation to use a deformable world and reload gravity and plane objects
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet physics simulation forward in a loop while the client is connected
